settings.setting: Implementation specification for the chat UI. The workbook supplies final copy; the live UI must consume these fields.

settings.behaviour: Show only the current choice with a dropdown chevron.
Jolly: playful, no swearing. Cheeky: bold, light language. Unfiltered: stronger language is allowed selectively, never by default in every card.
Use only when there is no valid remembered selection. Never silently upgrade to Unfiltered.
Persist jolly / cheeky / unfiltered and map it to the workbook Mode field.
settings.scope: Across sessions on the same browser/origin

settings.behaviour: Carry the choice into each bubble while keeping that bubble's pace and personality.
Local browser storage alone does not synchronise devices. Use an existing account preference service if cross-device sync is required.
Replace Opening Line / Ritual Card / Optional Check-in immediately from the selected Mode row. Keep current step, progress, saved state and history.
settings.scope: No new technique or repeat count

settings.behaviour: Choose the ritual through existing routing first, then select its wording. Do not route by profanity or treat modes as different rituals.
Give the opening visual prominence. All card text is visible immediately. No slow reveal, forced wait or required extra tap.
Ritual Card already starts with Opening Line. Split its first line for typography; do not prepend the separate field again.
Use the Optional Check-in supplied for that ID + Mode. Prompts deliberately vary across the library and allow shift, no shift, discomfort or something different without implying success.
Keep Mind Bend secondary and optional. Keep the existing Safety note accessible once alongside the card.
Use original Support First copy directly, with its safety block once. Preserve every emergency and severe-substance route.
For grief or serious distress, use the plain action-first version. Do not change the remembered preference. Immediate danger still routes to Support First.
Loss is never the punchline. This ritual deliberately uses the same compassionate card in all three modes.

settings.value: The mental story or its delivery
settings.behaviour: Avoid insulting the user, dismissing real problems, laughing at suffering, or turning responsibilities into things to ignore.
Tone changes delivery only. Do not add repetitions, exposure, physical actions or urgency.
Use as a simple optional link; preserve the selected intensity. No forced replay, streak threat or pressure to keep reading.
Validate the stored value. If a required mode is unavailable, use the same ID's default card; never change the technique silently.

settings.value: Read old thinkstill.vibe once if present
settings.behaviour: Map its valid jolly / cheeky / unfiltered value into thinkstill.intensity, then use the new key going forward.

bubbles.delivery: Dry, curious, mildly grumpy; expose the thought's delivery tricks.
bubbles.boundaries: Receipts, suspicious claims, noisy narrators; joke about the thought, never the person.

bubbles.delivery: Warm, unhurried; make room, loosen the grip and keep meaning local.
bubbles.boundaries: Light luggage, smaller pictures, modest pleasures; never dismiss loss or responsibility.

bubbles.delivery: Short, low-pressure invitations with dry humour; no shouting or forced happiness.
bubbles.boundaries: Off-duty committees, ordinary rooms, permission to pause; Unfiltered stays soft and uses no strong profanity.

bubbles.delivery: Friendly, inventive and practical; help a small part fit without judging the user.
bubbles.boundaries: Small repairs, missing links, mistaken paperwork; no robotic diagnostic prefixes.

bubbles.delivery: Theatrical and curious about replays, imagined futures and repeated checking.
bubbles.boundaries: Sequels, directors, scripts and echoes; do not encourage extra compulsive repetitions.

bubbles.delivery: Punchy, encouraging and mischievous; turn readiness into one bounded move.
bubbles.boundaries: Queues, permits, first steps, productivity jokes; no added urgency or risky challenges.

bubbles.delivery: Clear, warm and relational; organise competing feelings, roles and conversations.
bubbles.boundaries: Shared space, microphones, labels and social scripts; never ridicule a real person.
